svg.text: point-to-point companion to the placement insert (protoboard_layout.svg) · pin map = ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 v1.1, USB ports left · every wire in the list below

g.text: ● = solder joint · crossing without a dot = NOT connected · grey pins = reserved, leave alone

svg.text: 3-wire harness → strip DIN (chain start) — JST-XH 3-pin, row a, cols 34/35/36 ▶
5V/GND pigtail (20 AWG) → WAGO 221 on the slab DC rail
GND chain (row f) — insulated, stripped at G cols
socket rows b & i, cols 3–24 · ◀ USB ports face left
pin map below = v1.1 silkscreen — verify on your board before soldering
pin 1 (1OE) → GND — or no data output!
WIRE LIST — solder in this order (components are placed per the insert)
pigtail red 20 AWG: WAGO +5V → bottom +5V rail (left end)
pigtail black 20 AWG: WAGO GND → bottom GND rail (left end)
bridge 20 AWG: bottom +5V rail ↔ top +5V rail (before col 1)
bridge 20 AWG: bottom GND rail ↔ top GND rail (before col 1)
1000 µF: + → bottom +5V rail, − → bottom GND rail (at entry)
col 3 row a (DevKit GND, USB end) → top GND rail
col 4 row a (DevKit 5V, USB end) → top +5V rail
col 26 row a (IC pin 14, VCC) → top +5V rail
col 26 row j (IC pin 1, 1OE) → bottom GND rail
col 32 row j (IC pin 7, GND) → bottom GND rail
row a: chain cols 27·28·30·31 (IC pins 13/12/10/9), col 27 → top GND rail
row g: col 29 ↔ col 30 (pins 4/5) · row h: col 30 ↔ col 32 (to GND)
col 34 row b (LED 5V) → top +5V rail, around the JST body
col 36 row b (LED GND) → top GND rail, around the JST body
col 8 row a (GPIO 11) → col 25 row g · 470 Ω sits col 25→27 row h
col 28 row g (IC pin 3, 1Y) → col 35 row c (LED DATA), around the IC
S1: col 21 row j (GPIO 1) → col 38 row i
S2: col 20 row j (GPIO 2) → col 41 row i
S3: col 21 row a (GPIO 4) → col 44 row i
S4: col 20 row a (GPIO 5) → col 47 row i
S5: col 19 row a (GPIO 6) → col 50 row i
S6: col 18 row a (GPIO 7) → col 53 row i
S7: col 13 row a (GPIO 8) → col 56 row i
S8: col 10 row a (GPIO 9) → col 59 row i
insulated GND chain, row f: G cols 39·42·45·48·51·54·57·60 → bottom GND rail (right end)
off-board: LED JST → strip DIN (chain start) · S1–S8 JSTs → their wedge piezos (label the cables!)
off-board: pigtail lands in the WAGO 221 node on the slab DC rail · leave a USB service loop reachable
All signal wires 22 AWG stranded (insulated); power runs 20 AWG. Row a/j holes are the free holes above/below the socket pins — every other hole in those columns is hidden under the DevKit.
Wire colors follow the legend. Before first power-up: continuity-check +5V↔GND for shorts, then buzz each S column to its GPIO pin and the LED DATA pin to IC pin 3.
